import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by passenger class and sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Sex', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class\nMale', '1st Class\nFemale', 
                     '2nd Class\nMale', '2nd Class\nFemale',
                     '3rd Class\nMale', '3rd Class\nFemale'], rotation=0)

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

ax2.hist([survived_age, not_survived_age], bins=20, stacked=False, 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, label=['Survived', 'Did Not Survive'])
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend()

# Subplot 3: Survival rate by passenger class
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
survival_rate_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean() * 100
bars = ax3.bar(survival_rate_class.index.astype(str), survival_rate_class.values, 
               color=['#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11)

# Subplot 4: Survival rate by embarkation port
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
survival_rate_embarked = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean() * 100
bars = ax4.bar(survival_rate_embarked.index, survival_rate_embarked.values, 
               color=['#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11)

# Subplot 5: Fare distribution by survival and class
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
fare_data = []
labels = []
colors = ['#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']

for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):

    not_survived_fares = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare'].dropna()
    
    fare_data.append(survived_fares)
